questions.q: Which of the following is NOT listed in the Photosynthesis outline?
questions.exp: The nitrogen fixation pathway is not part of the Photosynthesis outline. The listed topics are: Photosynthetic Organisms, The Process of Photosynthesis, Plants as Solar Energy Converters, Plants as Carbon Dioxide Fixers, and Other Types of Photosynthesis.
